answer.reason: The verses tell of events in Galilee beyond what the summary says: its capture by Assyria and Jesus' work there.

clauses.english: was taken by Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and its people were carried captive
clauses.quote: and carried them captive to Assyria

clauses.english: was where Jesus went about teaching, preaching and healing
clauses.quote: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues

clauses.english: was where Jesus did his first miracle, at Cana
clauses.quote: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee

doubts: Left out the Kedesh in Galilee city-of-refuge and Levite-city lists, and Solomon's gift of twenty cities to Hiram, as lesser events.
Left out the many verses that only name where Jesus or others came from or travelled.
